papers.title: Beep: Balancing Effectiveness and Efficiency when Finding Multivariate Patterns in Racket Sports
papers.key_result: BEEP multivariate pattern mining: ~4.1x faster than SOTA Ditto on the table-tennis case study (1747->425 s) and ~5-9.7x on synthetic rows, with higher description-length gain and 2.6x fewer patterns at ~3x per-pattern frequency; miss codes surfaced a data-recording error. Transfer: play-pattern / coaching-analysis pipeline.

papers.title: Auxiliary Likelihood-Based Approximate Bayesian Computation in State Space Models
papers.key_result: Auxiliary-likelihood ABC: integrated-score ABC (AUKF-AR-IN) ranks #1 overall, beating 'exact' PMMH-BPF; S&P500 alpha-stable SV empirical: 500 ABC draws from 331,882 replications, 4h vs 12.5h for PMMH-ABCF, more reliable. Transfer: parameter inference for intractable GSE engine likelihoods.

papers.title: Predicting sports scoring dynamics with restoration and anti-persistence
papers.key_result: Restorative/anti-persistent scoring models: NBA bigram self-rate 0.35 (strongly anti-persistent); restorative-anti-persistent best all 9 NBA seasons on held-out LL; NFL: independent anti-persistent best 8/10 seasons; who-scores-next AUC beats all baselines for CFB/NBA and for NFL/NHL after >=50% of season. Transfer: in-game win-probability features.

papers.title: Are Betting Markets Better than Polling in Predicting Political Elections?
papers.key_result: Polymarket beat polling for the 2024 election: Trump win prob peaked ~67% in October; Polymarket 95% PI stopped crossing 50% from Oct 18 (firm Trump prediction) while polling never favored him; 5/7 swing-state PIs above 50% by mid-to-late October. Transfer: market-implied probability as calibration benchmark for GSE model probs.

papers.title: Large Language Models in Sport Science & Medicine: Opportunities, Risks and Considerations
papers.key_result: REJECT: perspective/opinion paper on clinical sports-medicine LLM use; no method, no dataset, no experiment, no equation, no numerical result; domain has no path to sports prediction, fantasy, or calibration. Full text read to EOF 2026-09-21 (remediation): remainder was only example ChatGPT/Bard sports-medicine responses; REJECT stands. Replaced by 1504 (SUMMIR, ADAPT).

replacements.title: SUMMIR: A Hallucination-Aware Framework for Ranking Sports Insights from LLMs
replacements.key_result: SUMMIR sports-insight extraction/ranking: 32,630 articles -> 7,900 relevant / 800 matches, 281,163 generated insights; Qwen 2.5 32B validation precision 88.5% / recall 89.1%; GPT-4o FactScore 95-97%, SummaC 60-72%; SUMMIR ranker NDCG@10 0.943, Recall@10 0.960. Code: github.com/nitish-iitp/SUMMIR. Transfer: NFL article validation -> structured insight extraction -> FactScore/SummaC hallucination gate -> engagement ranking on @GalaxySportsHQ data. Replaces REJECT 1478 (nlp lane).

papers.title: Kelly Criterion: From a Simple Random Walk to Lévy Processes
papers.key_result: Kelly criterion generalized from simple random walk to Levy processes: exact f*=4 for general Bernoulli (a=0.1,b=0.5,p=0.5); Cauchy case f*=1/2 with growth ln 2; log-normal numerics f*~4.16. Transfer: bankroll fraction sizing with fat-tail-aware growth-rate math.

papers.title: Local Temperature Scaling for Probability Calibration
papers.key_result: LTS (local, input-dependent temperature scaling): ECE All UC->LTS: COCO 12.44->10.04, CamVid 7.79->3.40, LPBA40 U-Net 5.58->0.90, VoteNet+ 7.26->0.71 - best vs TS/IBTS/IsoReg/VS/ETS/DirODIR everywhere. Entropy theory (Appx E, read to EOF): NLL-min equals entropy-max (overconfident) / entropy-min (underconfident); constraint order C>B>A. Transfer: context-conditional T(c) calibration for engine win probabilities.

papers.title: Dynamic quantification of player value for fantasy basketball
papers.key_result: H-score draft value: 20 simulated NBA seasons x 1,000 drafts -> 21.8% each-category / 37.7% most-categories win vs 8.3% chance; implicitly learns soft punting (~20% of weights below 0.95). Appendix (read to EOF): H-score cash-equivalence auction extension; correlated-Gaussian future-pick model; pruned scenario tree 634 multiplications (69% reduction); tipping-point gradient. Transfer: NFL DFS lineup/auction drafting optimizer.

papers.title: Time-varying Forecast Combination for High-Dimensional Data
papers.key_result: Time-varying forecast combination: NPRf (local-linear + reflection) lowest mean ASCFE and variance at every T; inflation NPRf 0.182/0.451 beats SPF (Reality-Check p=0.025/0.057/0.003) reversing Ang et al. (2007); equity-premium gSCAD 2.650 (x1000) best, selecting E/P, SVAR, NTIS, TBL, I/K. Thm 3 oracle property; Thm 1 CV-bandwidth consistency (Appx A proofs read to EOF). Transfer: smooth time-varying weights combining engine variants + market forecasts.

papers.title: Projective geometry for human motion, with an application to injury risk
papers.key_result: Reduced kinematic redundancy as injury-risk signal: Bowler B lost S3 support ~15 ms before release for ~30 ms and had the worse injury history (n=2, workload-confounded). Transfer: NGS movement-repertoire effective-rank / participation-ratio injury-risk feature.

papers.title: The Craft of Selective Prediction: Towards Reliable Case Outcome Classification
papers.key_result: Selective prediction on LexGLUE ECtHR (5 models x 4 losses x 4 confidence estimators x 3 tasks, 5 seeds): MC-dropout beats softmax response on every metric; CER improves selective metrics without hurting accuracy; domain pretraining helps but larger legal models are more overconfident. Transfer: GSE selective pick posting with AURCC / risk-coverage gates.

papers.title: Arnoldi Singular Vector perturbations for machine learning weather prediction
papers.key_result: Adjoint-free Arnoldi singular vectors for ML weather ensembles: blocksize 8 x 12 loops = 96-dim Krylov space on ICON/Pangu; A-SVs grow immediately while random noise takes ~4 days to recover initial amplitude; physically sensible patterns (jet-stream, polar-front shift). Transfer: stadium-weather ensemble spread features for totals/injury/DFS.
